howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: The threshold is not entered here; it is read automatically from the active shipping method — from the price tier at which shipping costs 0 €.
howTo.item2: The bar therefore only appears for shipping methods calculated by cart value that have such a tier. Without it, the bar simply stays hidden — no error is shown.
howTo.item3: Items flagged as free-shipping do not count towards the cart value.
howTo.item4: The bar is shown in the offcanvas cart and in the checkout summary.
howTo.item5: After changing texts or colours, run theme:compile so they reach the storefront.

info.description: Free shipping progress bar in the offcanvas cart and checkout summary.
